subject: Roadmap QBR – split timeband proposal and final slot confirmation
messages:
From: Alyssa King <alyssa@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Clearline Scheduling <scheduling@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Roadmap QBR — availability window (exec + product)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the partnership — we'd like to lock the Renewal/Expansion QBR + roadmap demo for the Clearline platform. We need a 75–90 minute slot that includes: a 20-min exec update, 30–40 min product roadmap + demo, and 15–20 min prioritization + next steps.

High-level constraints on our side: our CTO (Jason Lee) and Head of Product (Priya Menon) can only join between 10:00–13:00 ET on 10–12 Aug. We also have a handful of field leads in EMEA who would prefer a separate 30-minute walkthrough later the same day.

Can Redwood run a single consolidated session with an async EMEA deep-dive, or would you recommend splitting into two back-to-back windows? I'm attaching our proposed agenda (QBR-agenda-v1.pdf).

Proposed holds we placed: 10 Aug, 11 Aug, 12 Aug (10:30–12:00 ET). If any of those work for you please confirm and we’ll send the calendar invites.

Best,
Alyssa King
Sr. Program Manager — Customer Success
Clearline Health

Attachment: QBR-agenda-v1.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa King <alyssa@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap QBR — availability window (exec + product)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the detail and the agenda.

Short answer: we recommend a split timeband approach for coverage and to keep the exec portion tight. Proposed plan:
- 10:30–11:15 ET: Executive + topline renewal/metrics (Redwood exec + Clearline exec) – recorded.
- 11:20–12:20 ET: Product roadmap + demo + prioritization (working session with product/engineering stakeholders).
- 16:00–16:30 CEST (or recorded async session): EMEA-focused 30-min walkthrough and Q&A (optional live).

Rationale: keeps Jason and Priya for the exec portion without forcing them through the full demo and lets the product team run the deeper demo while execs step out if needed. We can consolidate notes and action items into a single mutual action plan.

We made small edits to the agenda and versioned it to QBR-agenda-v2.pdf (attached) — moved the success metrics to the first 10 minutes and added a short live-coding demo slot for the feature preview.

Questions for you:
1) Will Jason or Priya want to join the product session as well, or just the exec block?
2) Do you need Redwood to handle recording and redact any internal-only artifacts?

If that plan looks good we'll hold 10 Aug 10:30–12:20 ET + 10 Aug 16:00 CEST as tentative and follow up with a final invite.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa (CS lead) and Ben (technical host) so they can own logistics and runbook.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Attachment: QBR-agenda-v2.pdf
From: Clearline Scheduling <scheduling@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Alyssa King <alyssa@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 11:48:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Roadmap QBR — availability window (exec + product)

Hannah / Alyssa — calendar hold updated. We can confirm the following temporary holds (will convert to invites once Redwood confirms hosts):
- 2026-08-10 10:30–11:15 ET — Exec block (Jason Lee, Priya Menon) — tentative, Jason requested recording.
- 2026-08-10 11:20–12:20 ET — Product demo & prioritization (field + engineering).
- 2026-08-10 16:00–16:30 CEST — EMEA walkthrough (optional).

We added a note that Redwood should send a brief run-of-show and list of presenters by 6 Aug so we can finalize attendee invites. Alyssa also attached a vendor SSO checklist; sending back for your reference.

Tentative file: vendor-sso-checklist.xlsx
Calendly link: https://calendly.com/clearline/qbr-roadmap-90

Thanks,
Clearline Scheduling Team
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap QBR — availability window (exec + product)

Thanks all — plan looks good and we’ll own the runbook. Quick confirmations from Redwood side: 
- Hosts: Ben Carter (technical demo lead) and Marissa Cole (CS lead).
- Backup host: Hannah Schmitt (renewals) will cover exec Q&A if Ben gets pulled into engineering triage.
- Recording: confirmed — we will record the exec block and the product demo; we will redact internal-only slides prior to share.
- Prework: Ben will send a 2-slide pre-read + a link to a short recording of the feature preview by EOD 6 Aug.

Action items:
- Hannah: please send final invite once you receive the attendee list (HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/CL-2026-XL-72).
- Marissa: can you confirm whether we need to provision any temporary SSO test accounts for Clearline's engineers?

Alyssa — if that all sounds good please confirm and we’ll mark the holds as confirmed and publish the run-of-show.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
